latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of DeepSynClaw

- Introduces AI-powered compatibility matching based on deep psychological profiling, not just shared interests.
- Matches users for romantic, business, friendship, or custom partnerships.
- Compatible with OpenClaw and keeps user data local.
- Service is not yet live; profile builder and matching engine are still in development.
- Easy installation and plain language activation via agent chat.
